title: Building Community-Engaged Statistics and Data Science (CESDS) Courses
text:
GETTING STARTED
This handbook provides resources for developing and teaching community-engaged statistics and data science (CESDS) courses at the undergraduate level.
We define community-engaged statistics and data science (CESDS) courses as…
The handbook covers both the development and implementation of CESDS courses, including course design, project scoping, community partnerships, student project work, ethical considerations, common challenges, and project handoff and sustainability.
The handbook is being developed during the 2026-2027 academic year by a working group. More information about the project and working group is available on the CESDS website. Check back to learn more!
